typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		{Trade ID} as string,
		Counterparty as string,
		Product as string,
		{Trade Event} as string,
		{Pega Stage} as string,
		{Latest Comment} as string,
		Marketer as string,
		Trader as string,
		{Processing Org} as string,
		{External Chasers} as string,
		{Week Ending Date} as string,
		{Age of Trade} as string,
		{Days in Stage} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FlatFileSource	source(output(
		weekEndingDate as timestamp,
		tradeId as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> LookupLKPTABLE
FlatFileSource select(mapColumn(
		{Trade ID} = {Trade ID},
		Counterparty = Counterparty,
		Product = Product,
		{Trade Event} = {Trade Event},
		{Pega Stage} = {Pega Stage},
		{Latest Comment} = {Latest Comment},
		Marketer = Marketer,
		Trader = Trader,
		{Processing Org} = {Processing Org},
		{External Chasers} = {External Chasers},
		{Week Ending Date} = {Week Ending Date},
		{Age of Trade} = {Age of Trade},
		{Days in Stage} = {Days in Stage}
	),
	 skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	 skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion derive(loaddate = currentTimestamp()) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn,LookupLKPTABLE lookup({Copy of Week Ending Date} == weekEndingDate && {Copy of Trade ID} == tradeId,
	multiple: false,
	pickup: 'any',
	broadcast: 'none')~> Lookup
Lookup filter(!isMatch()) ~> Lookup0
Lookup0 sink(input(
		product as string,
		weekEndingDate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		trader as string,
		tradeEvent as string,
		processingOrg as string,
		ageOfTrade as integer,
		latestComment as string,
		loadDate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		daysInStage as integer,
		marketer as string,
		externalChasers as string,
		pegaStage as string,
		counterparty as string,
		tradeID as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		product = Product,
		weekEndingDate = {Copy of Week Ending Date},
		trader = Trader,
		tradeEvent = {Trade Event},
		processingOrg = {Processing Org},
		ageOfTrade = {Copy of Age of Trade},
		latestComment = {Latest Comment},
		loadDate = loaddate,
		daysInStage = {Copy of Days in Stage},
		marketer = Marketer,
		externalChasers = {External Chasers},
		pegaStage = {Pega Stage},
		counterparty = Counterparty,
		tradeID = {Copy of Trade ID}),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
